en.sayed-ali-raza: I am the axis of the mill.
It rotates on me while I remain in my position.
As soon as I leave it the centre of its rotation would be disturbed and its lower stone would also be disturbed.
By Allāh, this is a very bad advice.
By Allāh, if I had not been hoping for martyrdom by my meeting with the enemy—and my meeting with him has been ordained,
I would have secured my carrier and went away from you
and would not have sought you so long as North and South differed.
